### Purging Evil from the Church
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/purging-evil-from-the-church
Passage: 1 Corinthians 5:11-13
Points:
- Churches often swing between legalistic isolation from the world and permissive tolerance of unrepentant sin.
- Believers must maintain relationships with non-Christians to show love and share the gospel, as judging outsiders belongs to God.
- Continuing warm fellowship with a professing Christian who persists in gross sin gives them a false assurance of salvation.
- Formal discipline must follow biblical steps patiently with the goal of bringing the offender to repentance.
- When an individual remains impenitent, the church is called to expel them to preserve communal purity and integrity.
